name: Procurement rollout
whatIsChanging: Purchase orders move from email and spreadsheets to SAP Ariba. Buyers raise every PO in Ariba, and approvals route automatically by amount and cost centre.
why: Finance spends two days a month chasing PO approvals by phone, and a third of POs reach the supplier after the goods arrive.

name: New timesheets
whatIsChanging: Hourly staff log time in Workday instead of on paper, clocking in at the warehouse kiosk or in the Workday app.
why: Payroll spends four days keying in paper timesheets, and one paycheck in twenty needs a correction.

name: Expense cards
whatIsChanging: Corporate cards replace cash advances for travel and site visits.
why: Cash advances take a week to approve and a month to reconcile.

name: Travel booking tool
whatIsChanging: All business travel is booked through Navan instead of the travel agency inbox.
why: Agency bookings cost more and gave no view of who is travelling where.
